nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are some common algorithms used in SDMs as mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Common SDM algorithms include Generalized Linear Models (GLM), Maximum Entropy (MaxEnt), Random Forests (RF), Generalized Additive Models (GAM), and Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines (MARS).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy management systems|Intelligent energy management algorithms_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the main advantage of extreme learning machine (ELM) compared to artificial neural network algorithms in the prediction process?
nodes.answer: ELM demonstrates an outstanding generalization ability and a faster execution speed with fewer training parameters.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy management systems|Intelligent energy management algorithms_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What are some shortcomings of ELM mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: ELM has displayed shortcomings in parameter settings, which has led to the integration of intelligent optimization algorithms for better performance.
